# Glade

> Glade is a macOS desktop app for running many Claude agent sessions as tasks. Each task has one objective, runs in a
> workspace (a named root folder), and is either active or done. Other agents and scripts can drive it through its
> control API: one MCP server, `glade-control`, served on 127.0.0.1 behind a bearer token, with the same tools as plain
> JSON at `/v1/tools`.

To drive Glade, the user turns on Settings › Control › **Let agents control Glade** (off by default). Settings then
shows the command that connects Claude Code to it, with the token filled in:

```
claude mcp add --transport http glade-control http://127.0.0.1:45233/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
```

45233 is the default port. Glade's own tasks get the tools without that, in-process, and their agents get
`GLADE_CONTROL_URL` and `GLADE_CONTROL_TOKEN` in their environment, for scripts that call
`POST $GLADE_CONTROL_URL/v1/tools/<name>`.

## Driving Glade

- [Control API](https://github.com/lockhart-ai/glade/blob/main/docs/control-api.md): turning it on and connecting, the HTTP endpoint and its limits, every tool with its input and result, the error codes, scripting over `/v1`, backfilling past tasks and importing Claude Code sessions.

## Using Glade

- [User guide](https://github.com/lockhart-ai/glade/blob/main/docs/user-guide.md): using Glade day to day, from a first task to marking it done.
- [README](https://github.com/lockhart-ai/glade/blob/main/README.md): what Glade is, installing it, and building it from source.
- [Keymap](https://github.com/lockhart-ai/glade/blob/main/docs/keymap.md): every keyboard shortcut, and rebinding them.
- [Context menus](https://github.com/lockhart-ai/glade/blob/main/docs/context-menus.md): what right-clicking each thing offers.
- [Logs](https://github.com/lockhart-ai/glade/blob/main/docs/logs.md): where Glade's log is, the shape of a line, and what each scope logs.

## Extending Glade

- [Plugin API](https://github.com/lockhart-ai/glade/blob/main/docs/plugin-api.md): a plugin's manifest and sandbox, the events Glade sends its page and the messages it can post back.
- [Model surface](https://github.com/lockhart-ai/glade/blob/main/docs/model-surface.md): the tools Glade gives each task's agent (`set_title`, `set_status`, `ask`, …) and what it adds to the system prompt.
